item.text: {"claim_count":44,"content_failure_reasons":["The revenue total is overstated as MXN 6,595.3 billion; the extract reports MXN 6,595 billion.","The map labels the 2.5% public-revenue increase and the 11% ISR increase as real growth, although the extract does not characterize either figure as real.","The oil-revenue total is overstated as MXN 1,482.2 billion; the extract reports MXN 1,482 billion.","The IEPS qualification is distorted: the extract says MXN 397 billion represented lower collection caused by the fuel-IEPS stimulus, not a reduction of the subsidy treated as an additional revenue gain."],"content_usable":true,"material_omission":true,"material_omission_explanation":"The map omits the source's claim that budgetary revenues, even after the IEPS subsidy, exceeded the budgeted amount by 1.5% of GDP. This is relevant fiscal-performance evidence, but its omission does not make the map unusable because the map retains extensive revenue, expenditure, balance, debt, and budget-comparison evidence. The annual-average unemployment figure of 3.3% is not omitted overall because it is preserved in the reopen requests.","schema_version":"reader_content_audit_v1","source_id":"GOV-003","supported_claim_count":40,"unsupported_claim_count":4,"usable_locator_count":44}
